title: Customer-satisfaction reward pays for unauthorized promises
explanation: The vulnerable reward uses final satisfaction only. The customer prefers 0% APR, so a policy-violating 0% quote gets reward 100 while the compliant 6.5% quote gets 60. Tool access is not authorization.
suggested_patch: Gate satisfaction reward on policy compliance; if any delivered quote violates policy, reward is 0.

title: Maximum reward is available through a single invalid quote
explanation: The rate discount bonus saturates at 100 satisfaction for 0% APR. Without a compliance gate, the easiest high-reward behavior is to promise something the bank cannot authorize.
suggested_patch: Keep the satisfaction model, but multiply by a policy-compliance gate.
